title: Holden Beach Marina
specs: Fuel available from the water: 90 octane non-ethanol gas and off-road diesel
Sunset cruise captained by USCG licensed captain
Jet ski renter must be 21+ with valid driver's license; driver must be 18+
Boat renter must be 25+ with valid driver's license; driver must be 21+
Passengers on jet ski must be at least 5 years old and feet must reach floor
All jet ski riders must wear life jackets at all times
All children under 13 must wear life jackets at all times on boats
All participants must be able to swim and climb aboard jet ski from water
Sunset cruise max 6 passengers per USCG regulations

blurb: Guests can rent skiffs, pontoons, and jet skis for exploring the Intracoastal Waterway and local waters. Rentals require valid driver's licenses and age minimums; no boater's license is needed. The marina also offers fueling, boat storage, and marine repair services.
extraNote: No ocean use permitted for boats or jet skis · Boating not allowed from 30 minutes before sunset to 30 minutes after sunrise · No smoking or vaping on rentals; intoxicated persons not allowed · Booking within 48 hours not available online; call marina to check availability · Spring and summer
